insert into experience_comment (post_id, parent_id, user_id, content, target_user_id, target_reply_id, reply_count, like_count, is_author, hidden, create_time) values (#{postId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{targetUserId}, #{targetReplyId}, 0, 0, #{isAuthor}, #{hidden}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select ec.id, ec.post_id as postId, ec.user_id as userId, u.name as userName, u.avatar as userAvatar, ec.content, ec.like_count as likeCount, ec.reply_count as replyCount, ec.hidden, ec.create_time as createTime from experience_comment ec left join user u on ec.user_id = u.id where ec.post_id = #{postId} and ec.parent_id = 0 and (ec.hidden = 0 or ec.user_id = #{currentUserId}) order by ec.create_time desc

select ec.id, ec.parent_id as commentId, ec.user_id as userId, u1.name as userName, u1.avatar as userAvatar, ec.target_user_id as targetUserId, u2.name as targetUserName, ec.target_reply_id as targetReplyId, ec.content, ec.like_count as likeCount, ec.is_author as isAuthor, ec.hidden, ec.create_time as createTime from experience_comment ec left join user u1 on ec.user_id = u1.id left join user u2 on ec.target_user_id = u2.id where ec.parent_id = #{parentId} and (ec.hidden = 0 or ec.user_id = #{currentUserId}) order by ec.create_time asc
